title: Farmer crushed to death by boulder on cardamom plantation in Idukki
content: Idukki: A 59-year-old farmer was killed after a massive boulder rolled down and crushed him while he was working in his cardamom plantation on Saturday. The deceased has been identified as Benny Purayidathil (Sebastian P J), a plantation owner from Kadamakkuzhi in Kattappana. The incident occurred around 9 am at Benny's cardamom estate near Kadamakkuzhi. He and his wife were working in the plantation when a huge boulder dislodged from higher ground and rolled down, crushing him. Benny was trapped between the boulder and a water tank. His wife, who was working nearby, escaped without major injuries. The area is reportedly prone to rockfalls and landslides. It witnessed a major landslide in 2010, followed by two separate incidents of falling boulders in subsequent years. Benny was the brother of Thankachan Purayidathil, a former Kattappana Municipality councillor.
